evidence.evidence_text: To overcome this challenge, we innovatively propose a Memory Operating System, i.e., MemoryOS, to achieve comprehensive and efficient memory management for AI agents.

Extensive experiments on the LoCoMo benchmark show an average improvement of 48.36% on F1 and 46.18% on BLEU-1 over the baselines on GPT-4o-mini, showing contextual coherence and personalized memory retention in long conversations.

Inspired by the memory management principles in operating systems, MemoryOS designs a hierarchical storage architecture and consists of four key modules: memory Storage, Updating, Retrieval, and Generation.
Our pioneering MemoryOS enables hierarchical memory integration and dynamic updating.
